species.name: Millepora hydrocoral
species.habitat: Shallow reefs; distribution and taxonomy uncertain.
species.threat_summary: Severe declines and possible loss from Panama linked to ENSO; this is not global extinction. The latest assessment consulted is Data Deficient.
species.pdf_threshold_claim: 25–28 °C, anomalies >30 °C: not used as universal thresholds.

scenario.title: What evidence is missing before comparing aquatic refuges?
scenario.question: We have air temperature, humidity and rainfall from NASA POWER. What would you do before deciding on the aquatic habitat?

choices.label: Use air temperature as water temperature
Pick the site with the smallest p-value
Ask for water data series and habitat evidence

scenario.feedback: Correct: still needed: sea-surface temperature, accumulated heat stress, pH, reef habitat. Air temperature is not a substitute for sea and seabed temperature.
scenario.limitations: Complete species card and evidence exercise; there are not yet three aquatic refuge options or validated water series.
